semantics.elementCellId: Cell used to state the visual interactive in jss.f15.
semantics.pathType: World-pathfinding enum; 32 means Interactive. It is NOT the jss interactive type.
semantics.sourceCellId: Source-map cell from which the transition is taken.
semantics.targetMapId: Destination vertex map. For pathType 32 it equals transitionMapId in this asset set.
semantics.targetCellId: Not stored in the client world graph.
semantics.reciprocalSourceCellIds: Derived source cells on the exact reciprocal target->source edge; candidates only, never asserted as authoritative spawn cells.
semantics.criterion: Server/game-state route criterion; preserve alternatives and do not pick an unmatched route.
